verdict.rationale: Okta has explicit, first-party documentation for AI agent identity patterns: Cross App Access (XAA) for secure agent-to-app OIDC connections without exposing credentials, a dedicated XAA dev playground, and an official MCP server exposing Okta admin management operations to agents/LLMs. This directly addresses scoped agent credentials and agent access patterns, though token vaulting specifics and independent hands-on validation of these newer (2025/2026) features are thin. Missing for 10: independent/community corroboration of XAA and MCP server in production use, and explicit documentation of a distinct 'token vaulting' mechanism as named in the story.
